MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The heat shrink tubing complements my earlier crimp connectors by helping insulate and protect wire connections, so it serves a related repair step.",
    "A single roll of waterproof sealing tape fits my history of tape and vinyl adhesive purchases and feels useful for occasional patching jobs."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Ten tubes of glue or four rolls of sealing tape are more than I need now, even though the products themselves relate to my repairs.",
    "More connectors do not fill an obvious gap after my earlier assortment purchase, while the battery lugs and screws require specific projects and dimensions I have not indicated needing.",
    "The thermometer, large trash liners, and disposable masks do not address a current task I am trying to complete."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Gorilla tape purchases seem to have been taken as interest in other Gorilla products without enough attention to their purpose or quantity.",
    "Buying repair supplies seems to have been treated as a reason to want many kinds of tools and hardware, even when they solve unrelated problems."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I am more interested in supplies that add a useful next step to what I already own, such as protecting a connection, than in another large assortment of connectors.",
    "Package quantity matters to my decision: a relevant product can still be unnecessary when it means stocking much more than my current repair requires.",
    "Specialized parts need to match an actual task, including the wire gauge, fitting size, or material involved; general repair interest is not enough."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my repair interests but gave too little weight to complementary uses, exact project needs, and practical quantities."
}
